title: Computation of the Retainage Released at Closeout on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Computation of the Retainage Released at Closeout

The retainage released on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects at closeout is worked out from the retainage held on it, the share of that retainage the work has earned and the credits standing against it.

1. **The retainage held.** The retainage held on the project is the retainage withheld on its record less the retainage already released on it.
2. **The releasable retainage.** The whole of the retainage held is releasable.
3. **The share released.** The share released is the whole of the releasable retainage, that is 100 per cent of it.
4. **The gross release.** The gross release is the releasable retainage taken at the share released and rounded to the nearest cent.
5. **The credit set against the release.** No credit standing on the project is set against the release: 0 per cent of the credits on the project is taken off it.
6. **The retainage released.** The retainage released is the gross release less the credit set against it, rounded to the nearest cent, and where that difference falls below zero nothing is released.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Quantity | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| retainage withheld on the record | four withholdings | USD 24000.00 |
| retainage already released | one earlier release | USD 4000.00 |
| retainage held | 24000 less 4000 | USD 20000.00 |
| releasable retainage | the whole of the retainage held | USD 20000.00 |
| gross release | 20000 taken at 100 per cent | USD 20000.00 |
| credit set against the release | none of the credits on the project | USD 0.00 |
| retainage released | 20000 less nought | USD 20000.00 |

Where a project's record shows retainage withheld of USD 9000 and retainage already released of USD 9000, the retainage held is nought, the gross release is nought and nothing is released.
